subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Hallyu Wave Hits Television
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Hallyu Wave Hits Television.

hook.text: Hallyu—the Korean Wave—started with K-pop and K-dramas in the early 2000s.

buildup.text: Korean dramas combined romance, spectacle, and emotional intensity in ways that hooked audiences from Southeast Asia.

discovery.text: The South Korean government invested heavily in cultural exports.

twist.text: Netflix spent over 2.5 billion dollars on Korean content between 2015 and 2023.

climax.text: The Korean Wave proved that cultural soft power is real.

punchline.text: A small country's TV shows conquered the planet.

quiz.question: What role did the South Korean government play in the Hallyu Wave?
options: It invested heavily in cultural exports, treating entertainment as a strategic industry
